services.name: Sister Bay Village Segway Tour – Downtown & Waterfront
services.desc: Guided, beginner-friendly Segway tour through Sister Bay featuring village streets, waterfront views, and a relaxed 50-minute ride. 50 min. • Water, Cherries, & Goats • Starting @ $50

services.name: Fish Creek Segway Tour
services.desc: A relaxed, beginner-friendly guided Segway tour through Fish Creek that highlights waterfront views, village streets, and local landmarks. 50 min. • Niagara Escarpment & Downtown • Starting @ $50

services.name: Green Bay Riverwalk Sunset Segway Tour
services.desc: A guided, beginner-friendly evening Segway tour through Green Bay’s riverfront and downtown timed for sunset. 50 min. • Sunset Tour • Starting @ $50

services.name: Green Bay Packers Heritage Trail Segway Tour
services.desc: Guided Segway tour following the Packers Heritage Trail through downtown Green Bay, blending city riding with historical narration. 1.5 Hrs • Packers Franchise Beginnings • Starting @ $64

services.name: Lambeau Field & Titletown District Segway Tour
services.desc: Guided beginner-friendly Segway tour focused on Lambeau Field and the Titletown District with staged stops and training. 1.5 Hrs • Football District Glide • Starting @ $64

services.name: Green Bay – Thornberry Creek Scenic Segway Tour
services.desc: A guided, beginner-friendly Segway tour through quiet rustic roads and natural surroundings near Thornberry Creek, offering a calm, nature-focused 1.5 1.5 Hrs • Nature Glide • Starting @ $64

services.name: De Pere Downtown & Fox River Segway Tour
services.desc: A guided, beginner-friendly Segway tour through De Pere’s riverfront, downtown, and nearby neighborhoods at a steady, comfortable pace. 1.5 Hrs • Starting @ $64

services.name: Peninsula State Park Segway Tour – Scenic Door County Views
services.desc: Guided, beginner-friendly Segway tour through Peninsula State Park with overlooks, wooded roads, and regular photo stops. 2 Hrs • Most Popular Glide • Starting @ $89

services.name: Cave Point/Whitefish Dunes Door County Segway Tour
services.desc: Guided, beginner-friendly Segway tour exploring Cave Point and Whitefish Dunes with shoreline cliffs, dunes, and forested roads. 2 Hrs • Whitefish Dunes, Clark Lake & Cave Point • Starting @ $89

services.name: Ellison Bay Cherry Orchards Segway Tour
services.desc: Guided, beginner-friendly 2-hour Segway tour through Egg Harbor’s village streets, shoreline views, and wooded backroads. 2 Hrs • 1,000 Acres of Cherries • Starting @ $89

services.name: Baileys Harbor Lighthouse Segway Tour
services.desc: Beginner-friendly guided Segway tour of Baileys Harbor showcasing lighthouses, lakeshore roads, and coastal preserves. 2 Hrs • Lighthouses, Fishing Industry, & Nature • Starting @ $89

services.name: Sturgeon Bay Canal & Downtown Segway Tour
services.desc: A guided, beginner-friendly 2-hour Segway tour of Sturgeon Bay’s Canal City, waterfront, and downtown with training and photos included. 2 Hrs • FUN Along the Canal • Starting @ $89

services.name: Egg Harbor Vintage Segway Tour
services.desc: Guided, beginner-friendly Segway tour through Door County cherry orchards and Ellison Bluff with elevated Lake Michigan views. 2 Hrs • Vintage Door County • Starting @ $89

services.name: Appleton Downtown & Fox River Segway Tour
services.desc: A relaxed, beginner-friendly guided Segway tour through downtown Appleton and the Fox River waterfront, with unhurried narration and time for photos. 2 Hrs • #1 Tour in Fox Cities • Starting @ $89
